title: Prove one-disk cutover readiness
goal: After T001/T002, source integration, disposable activation proof, storage-harness implementation and final source integration are terminal and reviewed, prove one-disk NixOS cutover readiness on an exclusively reserved disposable non-production target using only the leased immutable rehearsal-source artifact produced by T007: rehearse the exact canonical LUKS2+Btrfs topology from a blank virtual disk, restore independently sourced off-host backup material, reconstruct and boot a fresh system, prove offline recovery, and finish with a reviewed evidence-complete cutover plan whose actual production device remains deliberately unbound for a later separately authorized destructive order.

approval.note: Runtime/block-device mutation is authorized only inside the exclusively reserved disposable storage-rehearsal sandbox and only after T004 and T007 are terminal. Declarative/reconstruction source acquisition is restricted to the separately leased immutable artifact.heim-pc.nixos-rehearsal-source produced by T007; /home/alex/repos/heim-pc/.git, mutable worktrees, moving branches, mutable locks and unpinned remote sources are outside T003 authority and must not be read for reconstruction or boot. The productive Heim-PC block devices, EFI, Secure-Boot, firmware, boot state and OS remain outside this authority.

acceptance.assertion: Before any block-device/runtime effect, T007 is terminal and independently reviewed, and T003 binds its exact final integration commit/tree plus terminal rehearsal-source artifact manifest and receipt. Evidence proves the final source includes the reviewed T006 integration state and reviewed T005 harness changes; any different or incomplete source identity fails closed.

T004 is terminal and independently reviewed, and T003 binds the exact approved activation-proof evidence, managed-build receipt, closure identity and rollback evidence. A failed, stale or source-mismatched T004 proof blocks T003 before any block-device effect.

Before declarative source bytes are read, T003 holds the artifact.heim-pc.nixos-rehearsal-source read claim materialized as the exact artifact path lease. Independent re-hash verifies the content-addressed artifact and manifest bind Git commit/tree, content digest, Control Release Set and lock/input identity exactly to T007 evidence.

Reconstruction and boot source acquisition read only the leased immutable T007 artifact. T003 has no /home/alex/repos/heim-pc/.git lease and no live source-path lease; any attempted read or reevaluation from the Git object store, mutable checkout, branch, mutable lock or unpinned remote fails closed before block-device/runtime effect.

Before sgdisk, wipefs, cryptsetup luksFormat, mkfs or boot mutation, the run holds the exclusive service.heim-pc-nixos-storage-rehearsal-sandbox claim and fresh independent evidence proves the target is a blank disposable virtual disk whose backing is not the productive Heim-PC root/system disk, not any mounted production filesystem and not production EFI/firmware state; ambiguity fails closed before effect.

Starting from the independently proven blank disposable virtual disk and only the verified T007 rehearsal-source artifact, the exact production-target topology GPT + EFI System Partition + recovery/boot-recovery surface + LUKS2 + Btrfs with @root, @nix, @persist, @home, @data and @containers is created, LUKS unlock is proven, every Btrfs subvolume is mounted correctly, the resulting disposable system actually boots, and independent readback proves the expected topology; the earlier LUKS+ext4 VM proof is not substituted for this gate.

Fresh read-only inventory classifies every migration-relevant non-reproducible data class separately from caches and rebuildable state; current scoped backup success is not treated as proof of complete cutover coverage.

Every critical migration data class is covered by sufficient physically/logically independent off-host storage and a staged realistic restore into the disposable rehearsal sandbox proves representative usable content; a capacity-constrained, production-disk-backed or non-independently-restorable backup target cannot satisfy this gate.

A fresh disposable system is reconstructed exclusively from the verified T007 content-addressed rehearsal-source artifact plus independently restored non-reproducible data, demonstrating that neither Git object-store access, mutable checkout state, hidden production-host state nor the original system disk is required for recovery. Boot/readback evidence binds the reconstructed system to the artifact manifest, exact source commit/tree and approved closure identity.

Independent bootable recovery media plus the required offline host/control closure, verified rehearsal-source artifact, lock/trust roots and LUKS/recovery material are verified without Grabowski, Bureau, network or the production system SSD.

The cutover plan defines the exact later device-binding procedure and required fresh evidence for model, serial number, mounts, root backing, health and recovery readiness, but deliberately leaves the actual production block-device identity unbound until a separate destructive cutover order authorizes it; historical WD_BLACK SN850X/nvme0n1 evidence is orientation only.

The terminal artifact is a reviewed evidence object/plan binding the approved T004 activation proof, exact T007 rehearsal-source artifact digest and source commit/tree, exact target topology, point of no return, rollback/reconstruction procedure, mandatory post-boot readback and all prerequisite backup/recovery evidence, while containing no current authorization or production block-device binding for the real cutover.

Although destructive commands are required inside the exclusive disposable sandbox, this task terminates before sgdisk, wipefs, cryptsetup luksFormat, mkfs, real EFI-partition mutation, Secure-Boot key mutation, firmware write, productive nixos-install, productive switch or reboot into a new production OS on the Heim-PC; such effects require a later explicit destructive-action order bound to fresh production-device and recovery evidence.

Exact T004 activation-proof, T007 source-artifact, target-preflight, VM/storage topology, boot/readback, backup restore, fresh reconstruction, offline recovery and final-plan evidence are independently reviewed before T003 is considered terminal.

metadata.historical_device_reference_not_authorit: WD_BLACK SN850X 2TB / historical nvme0n1 orientation only; actual production device identity is intentionally unbound in this task
